catalogue.description: Explicit plane realizations of the elliptically admissible extension orbits at the natural Halphen index. Each entry records a coefficient field, a smooth plane cubic, the complete ordered cluster of nine centers, and the classes of the prime (-2)-curves in the basis (L,E_1,...,E_9).
catalogue.theorem: For each of the twenty-six entries, blowing up the displayed ordered cluster gives an extremal Halphen surface of the stated index and extension orbit; the displayed class-matrix rows are the classes of unique geometrically integral (-2)-curves and form the declared affine ADE configuration.
catalogue.exclusion: The split D6+2A1 extension is absent because its middle group is (Z/2)^3, which cannot be a subgroup of a smooth elliptic curve; the two nonzero extension orbits are represented.

sections.label: Field and parameters
sections.tex:
Let \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{sp}}\) be the normalization over
\(\mathbb Q(\omega)\), where \(\omega^2+\omega+1=0\), of
\(\Phi_{\mathrm{sp}}(s,t)=0\). Put
\[
k=\mathbb Q(\omega)(\Gamma_{\mathrm{sp}}).
\]
On \(G=0\), the class \(p_5-p_3\) has exact order \(6\).

sections.label: Field and parameters
sections.tex:
Let \(\Gamma_{\xi=3}\) be the normalization of
\(\Phi_{\xi=3}(a,t)=0\). Put
\[
k=\mathbb Q(\Gamma_{\xi=3}).
\]
On \(G=0\), the class \(p_1-p_4\) has exact order \(6\).\\
Constant field &
The polynomial $\Phi_{\xi=3}$ is irreducible over $\mathbb Q$. The algebraic closure of $\mathbb Q$ in $k$ is $\mathbb Q(\omega)$, $\omega^2+\omega+1=0$; over this field the polynomial has two conjugate absolutely irreducible factors of total degree $10$.

$\begin{array}{lll}
p_{1}=(1:0:0) & p_{2}=(0:1:0) & p_{3}=(0:0:1)\\
p_{4}=(1:1:1) & p_{5}=(1:- \frac{t \left(a - 1\right) \left(a + 1\right)}{4}:t) & p_{6}=(- 2 \left(a + 1\right):\left(a - 1\right)^{2}:- 2 \left(a + 1\right))\\

sections.label: Cubic
sections.tex:
$\begin{aligned}
g_{1}&=2 t \left(a^{2} + 3\right) \left(a^{2} t + 2 a t - 2 a + t + 2\right),\\
g_{2}&=t \left(a - 1\right)^{2} \left(a + 1\right) \left(a^{2} + 3\right) \left(t - 1\right),\\
g_{3}&=4 \left(a - 1\right) \left(a + 1\right)^{2} \left(t - 1\right)^{2},\\
g_{4}&=- a^{5} t + a^{5} - 5 a^{4} t + a^{4} - 12 a^{3} t^{2} + 14 a^{3} t - 2 a^{3} - 12 a^{2} t^{2} - 2 a^{2} t - 10 a^{2} - 4 a t^{2} - 13 a t + 17 a - 4 t^{2} - 25 t - 7,\\
g_{5}&=- \left(a - 1\right)^{2} \left(a + 1\right) \left(t - 1\right) \left(a^{2} t + 2 a t - 2 a + t + 2\right),\\
g_{6}&=0,\\
g_{7}&=\left(a^{2} + 3\right)^{2} \left(a t - a + t + 1\right),\\
G&=\mathscr G(g_1,\ldots,g_7).
\end{aligned}$

sections.label: Cubic

$\begin{aligned}
g_{1}&=t \left(2 s - t - 2\right) \left(s^{2} - s t - s + t^{2}\right),\\
g_{2}&=- s t \left(s - 1\right)^{2},\\
g_{3}&=- t \left(2 s - t - 2\right) \left(s^{2} - s t - s + t^{2}\right),\\
g_{4}&=2 s^{4} - 4 s^{3} t - 6 s^{3} + 6 s^{2} t^{2} + 8 s^{2} t + 6 s^{2} - 4 s t^{3} - 8 s t^{2} - 4 s t - 2 s + t^{4} + 3 t^{3} + 2 t^{2},\\
g_{5}&=- s \left(s - 1\right)^{2} \left(s - t - 1\right),\\
g_{6}&=t \left(s - t - 1\right) \left(s^{2} - 2 s t + t^{2} + t - 1\right),\\
g_{7}&=- \left(s - 1\right) \left(s - t\right) \left(s - t - 1\right)^{2},\\
G&=\mathscr G(g_1,\ldots,g_7).
\end{aligned}$

$\begin{aligned}
g_{1}&=u^{2} \left(t - u\right) \left(u - 1\right)^{2} \left(t + u^{2} - u\right),\\
g_{2}&=u \left(t - u\right) \left(t + u^{2} - 2 u\right) \left(t + u^{2} - u\right),\\
g_{3}&=- u^{2} \left(t - u\right) \left(u - 1\right)^{2} \left(t + u^{2} - u\right),\\
g_{4}&=- \left(u - 1\right) \left(t^{3} + 2 t^{2} u^{2} - 4 t^{2} u + t u^{4} - 6 t u^{3} + 5 t u^{2} - u^{6} + 4 u^{4} - 2 u^{3}\right),\\
g_{5}&=- \left(t - u\right) \left(t + u^{2} - 2 u\right) \left(t + u^{2} - u\right),\\
g_{6}&=- u^{4} \left(u - 1\right)^{3},\\
g_{7}&=- u^{3} \left(u - 1\right) \left(t + u^{2} - 2 u\right),\\
G&=\mathscr G(g_1,\ldots,g_7).
\end{aligned}$
